target_customer: Hardware, robotics, commodities and food and beverage companies, plus SMEs and startups that need freight and procurement handled
problem: Freight forwarding, procurement, customs and shipment tracking are manual and fragmented, especially for hardware companies shipping physical goods.
business_model: AI enabled freight forwarding and supply chain service, handling procurement and logistics on behalf of customers
product_category: AI supply chain and freight forwarding automation

founders.name: Mert Turna
previous_startups: Hemut (YC P25), truck management operations company, co-founder
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built ship operations software used on 30+ vessels, while the launch post says 25+. VC and banking internships.

founders.name: Oguzhan Karaca
education: Oxford, Law (Pembroke College, inferred by the YC page from a student union role)
previous_startups: an AI native education business with six figure ARR
Diginak (Turkish digital freight platform, per a search result)
founders.background_notes: CEO title from a Turkish news quote seen in search; the YC page lists him as Cofounder.

competitors.name: Reform
competitors.what: AI powered workspace for freight forwarding

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly workflow automation on top of LLMs and carrier and document integrations. The hard part is operations and trust, not research.

defensibility.rationale: Many YC freight AI startups address the same workflow. Carrier and supplier relationships could become a moat but none is evidenced yet.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action against Derya found as of 2026-11.

market_need_then: Freight forwarding runs on email and manual documents. Derya says it handled over $15M in freight before expanding, a company claim. Hardware startups need shipping, customs and procurement help.

branding.name_origin: Derya is a Turkish word and given name meaning sea or ocean, from Persian; no source states why the founders chose it, and the original entity was called Derya Maritime per LinkedIn and Dealroom listings.
branding.domain_note: usederya.com redirects with a 301 to derya.ai, observed 2026-11.

identity.voice_and_tone: Not assessed; the site fetch for derya.ai returned a payment error

rebrands.why: Not stated; inferred only from differing entity names across listings

brand_strength.rationale: A pleasant sea related name that fits a freight business and a premium domain, but no press or community about the brand itself.

pivots.to: Full supply chain automation for hardware and robotics companies
pivots.why: YC page says they expanded from freight to full supply chain management; date not stated

outcome_analysis: Derya is an active Summer 2026 company that raised about $1.1M from YC, 212 and an angel in mid 2026. Founders bring maritime software and shipping legal experience, which fits the freight wedge. It faces several YC freight AI peers, so winning depends on operational execution in hardware supply chains rather than technology.
notes: The $1.1M figure was opened in Webrazzi (June 30 2026); other Turkish outlets repeat it in search results. Dealroom listing seen only in a snippet shows $468K on 2026-01-26 from 212, unverified and not recorded. Stage not stated by the source so recorded as other. Mert Turna and Karaca roles: YC page says Co-Founder for both; search snippet says CEO and CTO. Karaca's Oxford law degree is the YC page's inference.
